topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I just can't believe they're going through with this, you know? One day everything's fine, and the next, I get this little note slipped under my door about installing a fence. Like, what's the rush? We've been good neighbors for years, always helped each other out. No issues, no problems. Now this. It feels like they’re putting up more than just a fence; it’s like they’re shutting us out, walling off all the good times we’ve had side by side. I mean, I get privacy and all that, but there’s a way to do things, a way to talk it out first. Now, every time I look over, it’s going to be this cold, hard reminder of what could have been.
